upstreamTruth.formalNormalizedRow: Official/current normalized row already carries market identity as row.market.
upstreamTruth.propagation: Enrichment merge explicitly preserves market: row.market.
upstreamTruth.researchSnapshotGap: buildResearchSnapshot does not persist this exchange/market identity as a dedicated symbol-market provenance field.

couplingImpact: Market identity becomes dependent on monthly-revenue evidence availability rather than the already-known trading-market provenance.
A TWSE symbol missing from the monthly-revenue map becomes UNKNOWN_MARKET for margin/SBL/attention/disposition even when its exchange was known upstream.
A TPEX symbol with missing revenue likewise loses an independently known market identity.
Revenue-source coverage can therefore mechanically reduce other evidence-family coverage.

counterexample.conclusion: Known market identity is lost solely because an unrelated evidence family lacks the symbol.

safeRepair: Persist canonical sourceMarket/exchange from the Formal normalized row in the per-symbol decision-state receipt before research evidence collection.
External evidence collectors consume canonical sourceMarket; they never infer exchange from revenue presence.
Revenue record sourceMarket is retained separately as evidenceSourceMarket and checked against canonical sourceMarket.
Mismatch canonicalMarket vs evidenceSourceMarket => PROVENANCE_CONFLICT/AMBIGUOUS_SOURCE, not overwrite canonical identity.
Provider missing or symbol missing remains evidence-family UNKNOWN only; it must not erase market identity.

governance.researchSchemaChange: Part of Class-B immutable decision-state / evidence receipt proposal.
